topics.topic: How append_audit receives the import_snapshot operation's required audit timestamp without another clock read
questions: The required audit creates an AuditRecord containing occurred_at, but append_audit accepts neither the single instant nor an AuditIntent timestamp; which passage must change, or how can append_audit be made to use the operation's required instant without another clock read?

judgement.why: This asks the same question as P2, and neither the append_audit signature nor the AuditIntent fields quoted there have changed.

precedent.topic: How append_audit receives or handles the required occurred_at timestamp
quotes: IMPORTED FUNCTION SIGNATURES (these come from the imports above):
def append_audit(repository: AuditRepository, intent: AuditIntent) -> AuditRecord

- AuditIntent fields (exact, no others exist): action: AuditAction, actor_id: UUID | None, actor_kind: ActorKind, entity_id: str | None, entity_kind: AuditEntityKind | None, key_version: int | None, project_id: UUID | None, reason_code: str | None, result: AuditResult
precedent.why: The generated module can supply only an AuditIntent with no occurred_at field to the fixed append_audit signature, so append_audit owns the audit record timestamp and it is excluded from timestamps written by these operations.

topics.topic: Whether the operation's single UTC instant must determine the audit record's occurred_at timestamp and be passed to append_audit
questions: Must append_audit accept the operation's single UTC instant, or is the AuditRecord occurred_at timestamp excluded from "every timestamp it creates"?

Must the single instant also determine the required audit record's occurred_at timestamp? If so, append_audit must accept that instant (or AuditIntent must carry it); otherwise the behavior note must explicitly exclude timestamps created by append_audit.

judgement.why: T1 asks the same question as P4 on the same unchanged append_audit signature and AuditIntent field surface.
